name: FORGE
features: 60, 90 and 120 second manual rest presets shown within the real Train workout session
Rest timer pause, resume, plus 15 seconds and explicit reset using absolute clock deadlines
Session changes, rest days, account changes and conflicts clear the in-memory timer without touching personal logs
Large, accessible mobile-first controls and optional device vibration on completion
No new cloud data, workout edits, permissions or paid APIs
Regression tests verifying countdown drift, data integrity, account changes and mobile design
